 Tennessee #9 In Nov. 17 College Football Playoff Rankings
 November 17, 2026 | Football
 Share: KNOXVILLE, Tenn. -- Tennessee football comes in at No. 9 in the Nov. 17 College Football Playoff rankings with two regular season games remaining, the CFP Committee revealed Tuesday night. 
The Volunteers (8-2, 5-2 SEC) own a 16-point win over current No. 3 Alabama (26-10), a team it shutout in the second half. Their second-best victory is over current No. 16 Kentucky by 28 points, a team it also shutout in the second half in a 34-6 win two weeks ago. Both of Tennessee's losses are to current ranked teams by a combined six points -- No. 5 Texas  (20-17) and No. 21 South Carolina (27-24 in the final second). 
Among teams in the current poll, Tennessee is the only team with a double-digit win over a current top five team in No. 3 Alabama. 
The Vols host LSU at 3:30 p.m. ET Saturday on ABC. Neyland Stadium is sold out for the 34th consecutive game.
